claims.text: The Grey Point Trust voted on it in March, and the old lamp won by 40 votes to nine.
An electric lamp would have cost the Trust 140 thousand dollars before a single night of light.
Last winter the ledger showed 60 ships turning back at the bar, twice the number of the year before.
I trim the wick at dusk, wind the clockwork every four hours, and write the ledger before I sleep.
The Grey Point Trust pays for the apprentices out of visitor tickets and a small grant from the county.
There is a plan from the county to build a visitor centre on the meadow behind the keeper's cottage.
Tobias Renn, keeper of the Grey Point lighthouse, thank you for showing us the ledger and the lamp.

headline: Mara talks to the keeper of the Grey Point lighthouse about the ledger he keeps, and why the Harbour Board disputes what it shows.

quotes.speaker: unknown
quotes.text: Today we are at Grey Point with Tobias Renn, who has kept the lighthouse there for 30 years.

quotes.speaker: unknown
quotes.text: Tobias Renn keeps a ledger of every ship that passes, and the ledger is the reason we came.

title: A ledger since 1902
